query:
SELECT
                    c.owner_signature_key as "verifying_key: BlobDecoded<QsClientVerifyingKey>"
                FROM
                    qs_client_record c
                JOIN qs_user_record u ON u.user_id = c.user_id
                WHERE
                    c.client_id = $1
                    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
                    AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
